selectionConclusion: No unblocked park is proven immediately closeable by this read-only triage. Acqua Gliss has the narrowest remaining content gap. Fresnes and Cousteau could close quickly only after the existing application label defect is corrected; it is still observable today. Droséra is a reserve with unresolved qualification; Île aux Géants is the most advanced active candidate outside current work. These are conditional priorities, not claims of completed audits.
